description: This file defines an abstract base class `AggregateBase` for statistical aggregation functions within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library. It contains protected static helper methods for handling booleans and countable value validation, considering different spreadsheet application compatibility modes.

classes.name: AggregateBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing helper methods for statistical aggregation calculations, specifically handling booleans and countable values based on compatibility modes.

methods.name: testAcceptedBoolean
methods.description: Determines how booleans are counted or interpreted based on spreadsheet compatibility mode and whether the cell value is considered in calculations.

methods.name: isAcceptedCountable
methods.description: Checks if a value is countable for statistical calculations, considering null values, numeric/string types, cell references, and compatibility modes.
